anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: || papyrus page 19. Continues Witte p.110 / PDF 114.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: what was from the beginning… our hands have handled concerning the word of life.

pass_a_gloss: as also John: What was, he says, from beginning, what we have heard and seen with our eyes and our hands handled concerning the word of life — then we shall also be able to sacrifice the sheep and eat and so come out of Egypt [gap].
pass_b_english: [as] John too: "What was," he says, "from the beginning, what we have heard [and] seen with our eyes and our hands have handled concerning the word of life" — then we shall also be able to sacrifice the sheep and eat [and so come out of Egypt] [lacuna]
source_text: [ὡς κ]αὶ ὁ Ἰω[άν]νης· "Ὃ ἦν" γάρ φ[ησιν] "ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς, ὃ ἀκηκόαμεν κ[αὶ ἑ]ωράκαμεν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν κ(αὶ) αἱ χεῖρες ἡμῶν ἐψηλάφησαν περὶ τοῦ λόγου τῆς ζωῆς", τότε καὶ θῦσαι τὸ πρόβατον δυνησόμεθα καὶ φαγεῖν|| [καὶ οὕτω τὴν Αἴγυπτον ἐξελθεῖν] ...
